items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: He had a band there and his wife was the only music teacher in Napoleonville, Mrs. Nelson.

ctx.x: He's originally from Alexander Louisiana. He was a band leader at 50 years. Oh really? I've heard the name but I don't remember for sure. Well, I was his drunk player when he died. After he died, we played his funeral, funeral, buried him. Then I came back to New Orleans.

Yeah. Um, were there any bands in Napoleonville? How big, I don't, I've been through there on the bus but never did stop to see the town. Well, there was bands there. Um, Dr. Nelson had a band. That was a colored doctor. He has two sons here right now. There's Lewis Nelson and George Nelson. Oh, it's that doctor. I knew the Dr. Nelson. He just died, you know, a month or two ago. Well, that's Lewis Nelson's dad. And he was up there. He had a band there and his wife was the only music teacher in Napoleonville, Mrs.…
And by the way, the first job I ever played in my life, I played it with Lewis and George Nelson. That is in Napoleonville, because we both walked in the same town.
